Fig. 1. TRACE pipeline. Left: DyadEE dataset construction with natural dyads (original conversations and their voice-converted and denoised variants) and disrupted dyads generated via partner swapping and emotion-contradicting resynthesis, each annotated with conversational context and relationship category. Right: TRACE models dyadic interaction using window-level embeddings from an emotion-fine-tuned Whisper encoder for emotional entrainment classification.
